title: Rellich-Kondrachov compactness on the unit ball
statement: Let n >= 1 and A in R, and let f_k : R^n -> R and g_k : R^n -> R^n (k in N) satisfy IsW12WithGradient f_k g_k B, int_B |f_k|^2 <= A and int_B |g_k|^2 <= A for all k (bounds stated as ENNReal.ofReal A; B is the open unit ball). Then there are a strictly increasing phi : N -> N and w in L^2(B) (MemLp w 2 for Lebesgue measure restricted to B) with int_B |f_{phi(k)} - w|^2 -> 0.
lean_statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ (A : ℝ) (f : ℕ → Rn n → ℝ) (g : ℕ → Rn n → Rn n), (∀ k, IsW12WithGradient (f k) (g k) (ball 0 1)) → (∀ k, ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ‖f k x‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal A) → (∀ k, ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ‖g k x‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal A) → ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (w : Rn n → ℝ), StrictMono φ ∧ MemLp w 2 (volume.restrict (ball (0 : Rn n) 1)) ∧ Tendsto (fun k => ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ‖f (φ k) x - w x‖ₑ ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0)
